correctness.rationale: The flag-complex link argument forces at least eight triangles for a mod-3 essential cycle; if there were fewer than eight, vertex link degrees and the absence of nonzero H_2 in a flag complex on <=5 vertices give a contradiction. At eight, all six supported vertices have link degree four, yielding K6 minus a perfect matching and an induced octahedral support. The published H_2(M_5,5;Z)=Z/3 and H_1=0 are appropriately used as background. An independently inspected frozen COCHAIN.json had 184 nonzero F3 entries, closed on all 600 genuine tetrahedra, and paired 2 with the specified eight-face sphere; it certifies nontriviality. Independent enumeration over all six-square sets found 900+900 induced octahedra, incidence counts 432 per square, 54 attacking and 108 compatible pairs. All orbits follow symmetry. The cochain certificate proves one generator and symmetry extends it; it is not a proof of an arbitrary larger board.
